messages:
Nadia: Wrapping up the Apr 22 outage postmortem. Need to finalize customer comms: 1) statuspage blurb, 2) 72h public summary, 3) enterprise outreach, and 4) the RCA access sentence + request flow. Also capture owners and deadlines so the action tracker is neat.

Ethan: I can take the statuspage blurb. Will keep it short and non-technical.

Priya: I'll draft the 72h public summary (public audience). Can I have until 2024-04-26 17:00 PT? Will loop Legal for redactions.

Luis: I will prepare enterprise templates and suggested CS scripts. ETA 2024-04-26 COB. Will include offer for private briefings.

Harper: Proposed RCA policy sentence: "A redacted public summary will be posted; verified impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive details may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Thoughts?

Nadia: That looks good. Ethan, can you append a short note for how customers request the RCA (link to support + reference ticket #)? We should avoid exposing internal incident numbers in public copy.

Ethan: Draft statuspage snippet: 
```
Status: Partial service disruption — Resolved
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced elevated latency and errors for some requests. We mitigated the impact and service is operating normally. A public summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```

Priya: Suggest adding one line about recurrence: "We observed patterns similar to prior KV cache eviction spikes and will include next steps in the 72h summary." Keeps transparency without being technical.

Harper: Legal prefers the RCA sentence to say "verified impacted customers may request a detailed RCA through Support; sensitive information may require an NDA." I'll update wording and send back.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-7201 created and assigned to Luis for enterprise outreach. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-7201

Luis: Enterprise outreach plan: targeted emails, CS script, and offer for 1:1 briefings for materially impacted accounts. Will include an escalation path to Solutions Eng. ETA 2024-04-26 COB.

Nadia: SRE follow-up: this recurring KV cache eviction pattern needs an owner and a mitigation timeline. Mateo volunteered in the postmortem; can someone open a tracker item and assign to Platform SRE?

Priya: I'll note the recurrence in the 72h doc and ask SRE to open mitigations task if needed. ETA for mitigation proposal from SRE: 2024-05-06 per postmortem notes.

Nadia: Action items to add to tracker:
- statuspage copy: Ethan -> staging 2024-04-25 17:30 PT, publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Priya -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- enterprise outreach/templates: Luis -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA access blurb & legal signoff: Harper -> legal signoff 2024-04-28
- recurrence mitigation plan: Platform SRE/Mateo -> proposal 2024-05-06

Ethan: I'll push statuspage draft to staging after Harper's final wording. Target publish time confirmed.

Harper: Sent the RCA policy wording to Legal; they expect to respond by 2024-04-28 with small wording suggestions.

incident-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 1767045000 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).

Nadia: Thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to sign off on final copy. :white_check_mark:
